item.title: PepsiCo to raise some chip prices as input costs bite
item.description: PepsiCo is set to raise prices for some chips to keep pace with inflation, a spokesperson for the company said, as the Lay's maker works to revive sales in the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: PepsiCo (PEP.O) is set to raise prices for some chips to keep pace with inflation, a spokesperson for the company said, as the Lay's maker works to revive sales in the United States. PepsiCo is navigating shifting consumer preferences toward healthier snacking, weak demand from households pressured by rising fuel prices and higher commodity costs this year. In February, PepsiCo [USN:L4N3YZ0W4 TEXT:"cut prices"] by up to 15% on products including Lay's and Doritos after customer backlash against several rounds of previous price hikes. The fresh round of price hikes will be implemented for some chip brands in the low- to mid-single-digit percentage range, which was in line with inflation, a spokesperson for PepsiCo told Reuters. The new prices will be lower than they were before the price cuts earlier this year, and the company is trying to maintain lower prices where it can, the spokesperson added. Prices are expected to go up on products including grocery-store-sized bags of chips from brands such as Doritos and Ruffles, and some sodas by the end of this year or in early 2027, according to a report by Bloomberg, which first reported the hikes, citing people familiar with the matter. Activist investor Elliott Investment Management, which disclosed a roughly $4 billion stake in PepsiCo last year, [USN:L4N3UP0TL TEXT:"has pushed"] the company to reinvigorate its soda business, boost its share price and explore selling non-core food assets. Elliott did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. PepsiCo shares, which have fallen nearly 10% so far this year, dipped about 1% in morning trading. Several food and beverage companies have been contending with rising packaging and logistics costs as the Iran war keeps oil prices elevated. [USN:L4N43B0SO TEXT:"In its latest earnings report"], PepsiCo warned of higher commodity costs in the second half of the year and posted a 2% drop in second-quarter sales in its North American food business, although it kept its annual forecast intact. The company also said in July that high gas prices had dented consumer demand more than it had anticipated. Volumes in PepsiCo's North America business have been negative through this year, despite the price cuts and CEO Ramon Laguarta's plan to review its North America supply chain, which was announced in December. With North America unlikely to recover this year despite PepsiCo's efforts, "everything is likely 'in play' for Elliott to dial up activism," said BNP Paribas analyst Kevin Grundy in a note on Wednesday.

item.title: Heavy rains hit Mexico as Hurricane Polo tracks offshore, expected to make landfall on Sunday night
item.description: Heavy surf and rain lashed southwestern Mexico as "extremely powerful" Hurricane Polo crawls northwest offshore the mainland, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said in a bulletin on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Paolo Laudani
item.content:encoded: Heavy surf and rain lashed southwestern Mexico as "extremely powerful" Hurricane Polo crawls northwest offshore the mainland, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said in a bulletin on Thursday. With maximum sustained winds near 160 miles per hour (260 kph) Polo has been classified last as a Category 4 storm, a notch down from level 5, the highest level on the Saffir-Simpson scale, which it had previously reached. As the NHC keeps adjusting the storm's force, it said it could see some near-term strengthening and is expected to remain a major hurricane for the next few days. AccuWeather, a private forecaster, expected Polo to make landfall late Sunday night into Monday, to lose some steam and to reach a Category 2 hurricane as it tracks across the Baja California peninsula north of Cabo San Lucas, where local authorities have already begun restricting beach access and closing the local harbor. The NHC said that Polo's outer rainbands are spreading onshore and producing heavy rains. Tropical-storm-force winds are likely occurring along the coast of southwestern Mexico, it said. Polo's hurricane-force winds extend outward up to 40 miles (65 km) from the center and tropical-storm-force winds extend outward up to 125 miles (205 km). Rainfall totals of 4 inches to 6 inches (102 mm to 152 mm), with isolated maximum totals up to 8 inches, are expected across coastal areas of Mexico's Guerrero state on the Pacific coast through Thursday, possibly triggering life-threatening flooding and mudslides. Coastal areas of the Mexican states of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco are also forecast to experience heavy rains, while swells generated by Polo will affect portions of the coast of southwestern Mexico during the next couple of days. "These swells are likely to cause life-threatening surf, rip currents, and coastal flooding," said the NHC. AccuWeather hurricane expert Nicholas Arman said that if the hurricane stays on the expected track, some rain and moisture can be pulled into Texas. “This is textbook[USN:L6N45F0NL TEXT:" El Niño"] impacts where the strong tropical development in the Pacific ultimately pushes moisture into the southwestern US,” he said How much rain and moisture reaches Texas depends on the storm’s ability to cross the Sierra Madre mountains, a major mountain range system which runs northwest–southeast through northwestern and western Mexico, and along the Gulf of California. “The Sierra Madre often act like a cheese grater to an organized system, shredding it apart and preventing any organized tropical feature from staying together,” Arman added.

item.title: 米新築住宅販売、8月は6.4％増の68.4万戸 8カ月ぶり高水準
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した８月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新築住宅販売、8月は6.4％増の68.4万戸　8カ月ぶり高水準 9/24 23:59 配信

米ニューヨーク州ロングアイランドで2025年8月撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した８月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比６．４％増の６８万４０００戸と、２０２５年１２月以来の高水準となった。買い手が値引きなどの販売促進策を利用したことで８カ月ぶりの高水準に急増したものの、中東情勢を背景とした住宅ローン金利の上昇は依然として住宅市場の足かせとなっている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は６１万５０００戸だった。

前年同月比では２．０％減少した。

７月分は当初発表の６０万７０００戸から６４万３０００戸に上方改定された。

地域別では、中西部が８４．９％増、南部が６．９％増と大きく伸びた一方、北東部は３６．１％、西部は１５．２％、それぞれ減少した。

新築住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比５．８％下落の３９万３７００ドル。８月に販売された住宅の大半は４９万９９９９ドル以下の価格帯だった。

新築住宅在庫は４８万３０００戸と７月から横ばい。うち半分以上は建設中だった。

８月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は８．５カ月。７月は９．０カ月だった。

item.title: Petrobras entende que haverá consenso com credores da Braskem, diz diretor
item.description: A Petrobras , como acionista da Braskem , participa do processo de recuperação extrajudicial da petroquímica e entende que um consenso com os credores será alcançado, afirmou o diretor de Processos Industriais e Produtos da estatal, William França, nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) , como acionista da Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , participa do processo de recuperação extrajudicial da petroquímica e entende que um consenso com os credores será alcançado, afirmou o diretor de Processos Industriais e Produtos da estatal, William França, nesta quinta-feira. "Estamos buscando garantir um plano de estruturação de capital dentro da RE (recuperação extrajudicial), que permita que a Braskem se estruture operacionalmente na parte logística e na parte financeira também", afirmou França, a jornalistas, ao participar do congresso de petróleo e gás ROG.e. Questionado se a Petrobras poderia injetar capital, França disse que "nada foi decidido" ainda. "Nós temos até dia 24 de novembro para fechar o acordo de RE com os credores", adicionou. Também presente no evento, a presidente da Petrobras, Magda Chambriard, afirmou que "não está no nosso escopo estatizar a Braskem" e que uma eventual injeção de recursos precisaria ser uma iniciativa junto com parceiros.

item.title: 米追加利上げ必要になる可能性、インフレ目標回帰へ＝フィラデルフィア連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２４日 ロイター] - 米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁は２４日、高止ま...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ必要になる可能性、インフレ目標回帰へ＝フィラデルフィア連銀総裁 9/24 23:40 配信

米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁。ワシントンで４月撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci

Michael S. Derby

[２４日 ロイター] - 米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁は２４日、高止まりするインフレ率を米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の目標である２％に戻すには、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見解を示した。

ポールソン氏は同地区連銀で開催されるイベントの講演原稿で、インフレは「依然として高止まりしている」とした上で、「インフレ率を２％に戻すことが最優先課題であり、労働市場へのリスクを慎重に見極めつつ、目標達成につながる政策方針を支持していく」と語った。

また、「今後、状況が私の想定通りに推移すれば、控えめな追加引き締めが正当化される可能性がある」と述べ、インフレを望ましい水準に戻す上で必要になるとの認識を示した。

ポールソン氏はＦＲＢの先週の利上げ決定を支持したとした上で、会合前に「リスクバランスが変化した」ほか、「基調的なインフレの改善がほとんど、あるいは全く見られなかった」と指摘した。

さらに、インフレ押し上げの一因として、テクノロジー分野への旺盛な投資を指摘した。

米経済については「かなり底堅く、勢いを増しつつある兆候を示している」と言及。「関税措置や中東の紛争によるショックにもかかわらず、足元の消費の伸びは堅調であり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の投資拡大が投資全体をけん引しており、労働市場も安定している」との見方を示した。

ポールソン氏は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持つ。

item.title: New US sanctions shut down Iranian flights
item.description: Iranian airlines were barred from neighbouring countries including the UAE and Oman on Thursday in response to new US sanctions, the first big impact of a shift in US policy to target companies in third countries that do business with Iran.
item.dc:creator: Federico Maccioni, Eman Abouhassira, Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: Iranian airlines were barred from neighbouring countries including the UAE and Oman on Thursday in response to new US sanctions, the first big impact of a shift in US policy to target companies in third countries that do business with Iran. The General Civil Aviation Authority of the United Arab Emirates, the Middle East's biggest travel hub, said that as a result of the new US policy it was suspending all flights by Iranian airlines until further notice. Iran's Tasnim news agency reported that flights had also been shut down to Oman, Georgia and Azerbaijan, and to the Iraqi capital Baghdad. It said authorities were working to route flights to another Iraqi airport, in Najaf, a major Shi'ite Muslim religious pilgrimage site. Washington had announced it would put sanctions on any global companies doing business with Iranian airlines after September 23, with the aim of grounding Iran's entire civil fleet worldwide. Other countries in the Gulf region also appeared to have restricted flights. Tehran's Imam Khomeini Airport listed scheduled arrivals and departures on Thursday to and from countries including Afghanistan, Armenia, China, Iraq, Pakistan, Tajikistan and Turkey. But no flights appeared to be listed to or from the nearby Gulf states, with which Iran has long had some of its most important business and travel ties. Iran has suggested that enforcement of a US-mandated air blockade would lead to potential escalation. On Wednesday, a senior Iranian official threatened to make airports "unusable" in any regional country that abides by the US ban. Separately on Thursday, authorities in Saudi Arabia said they had intercepted [USN:L1N45G0BD TEXT:"intercepted six ballistic missiles"] fired by Yemen's Houthi fighters. The Houthis said they had fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets. An escalating conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis has emerged this month as the combat zone in the wider Middle East war. 'ECONOMIC D-DAY' With the US-Israeli war against Iran largely stalemated for months on the battlefield, Washington has announced a shift in tactics to extend the reach of its financial sanctions by targeting companies from third countries that do business with Iranian firms, a practice known as "secondary sanctions". Trump referred to the new strategy last month as "economic D-Day", comparing it to the assault on Nazi-controlled France in World War Two by the United States and its allies. A flight ban, if sustained, could deepen Iran's isolation and worsen an economic crisis in the country, which is already facing a US blockade of its ports at sea. "We are living in an open-air prison," a retired teacher in Tehran told Reuters by text message on condition her name not be used. SAUDI ARABIA SAYS IT SHOOTS DOWN HOUTHI MISSILES The war, which Trump launched alongside Israel in February as "Operation Epic Fury", has disrupted global energy supplies, killed thousands of people and pushed up [USN:L1N45G03T TEXT:"oil prices"]. Conflicts have been reignited in other regional countries where Iran has allies, initially in Lebanon and now in Yemen, where the Houthis declared a blockade on Saudi Arabia in July and launched a lightning advance this month against a Saudi-backed government. The Houthis have repeatedly fired into Saudi Arabia this month, and say the Saudi air force has conducted hundreds of strikes on Yemen since fighting escalated. Saudi Arabia said it had intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles on Thursday, after issuing emergency alerts for areas including the holy city of Mecca, Jeddah and Yanbu, the main Saudi Red Sea oil port. "Any escalation and violations by the terrorist Houthi militia will be dealt with firmly," a Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen said in a statement. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the group had attacked Saudi military sites in Jazan province bordering Yemen, targeting operations rooms, command and control centres, weapons depots, missile launch sites and military camps. Sources in the internationally recognised, Saudi-backed Yemeni government said their forces had repelled overnight Houthi attacks on a key supply route to Aden, the Indian Ocean port city where the government is based. The Houthis, who already controlled the north including the capital Sanaa, seized Yemen's entire Red Sea coast this month and have been pushing into adjacent highlands near the central mountain city of Taiz and the road from Aden. The Houthis have kept up pressure on government forces holding a steep winding mountain pass known as Hejat al-Abd, a lifeline for [USN:L1N45D0B1 TEXT:"hemmed in"] pro-government forces, and for goods entering Taiz. Seizing parts of the Taiz-Aden road could allow the Houthis to tighten their grip around Taiz and deal another blow to the government, which has struggled to regain the initiative since losing the western coast. More than 700 people have been killed and thousands wounded in the latest fighting, according to the United Nations. Nearly 130,000 Yemenis have been displaced within the country, while more than 3,000 have fled by boat across the Red Sea to Africa.

item.title: 米中首脳、AI巡る激しい競争認める－ホワイトハウスで会談へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は24日、中国の習近平国家主席をホワイトハウスに迎え、両国関係の安定維持を目指して会談に臨む。両首脳は互いの友情をたたえつつ、両国間の激しい競争も認めた。

ホワイトハウスの南庭で、トランプ氏と習氏はそれぞれの配偶者とともに握手を交わし、公式写真の撮影に応じた。歓迎式典では、軍による観閲式や贈答品の交換、航空機の上空通過が予定されている。

ただ、こうした華やかな演出の一方で、超大国として競合する米中間には、貿易やAI、台湾を巡る長年の対立がくすぶっている。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスの玄関ホールで演説し、「習主席と私は協力して、両国が直面する課題への対応で大きな進展を遂げてきた」と述べた。新設された貿易委員会の下で、米国の農家や牧場主による中国市場へのアクセス拡大でも進展があったと説明した。

習氏は米国との意思疎通を強化するよう呼びかけ、「対立すれば双方が損失を被る」と述べた。直行便をさらに増やす余地があるとしたほか、数日中にパンダ2頭がジョージア州のアトランタ動物園に到着すると発表した。

習氏はAIの管理についても両国に責任があると指摘。「中国と米国はAI分野をリードする国であり、AIを社会に役立つ形で開発・管理し、その発展が常に人間の管理下に置かれるようにする能力と責任が双方にある」と述べた。

トランプ氏は、両首脳が安全保障やテクノロジー、AIに関連する問題についても協議すると述べた。「共通の利益に焦点を当てれば、歴史に残る多くの成果を上げられると確信している」と語った。

今回の訪問は、トランプ氏にとって難しい時期に行われる。イランとの戦争に踏み切ったことで生活費高騰が深刻化しているためだ。物価高は有権者の不満を招いており、11月の中間選挙では共和党が議会の支配権を失う恐れがある。

習氏は、前例のない4期目入りを来年に控える中で訪米した。レアアースを巡る中国の圧倒的な支配力も、北京に持続的な交渉力をもたらしている。一方、習氏は低調な経済成長と若者の失業率上昇にも直面している。

item.title: Taxas de juros seguirão em patamares restritivos, diz diretor do BC
item.description: O diretor de Assuntos Internacionais e de Gestão de Riscos Corporativos do Banco Central, Paulo Picchetti, reforçou nesta quinta-feira que a instituição faz atualmente uma "calibração" da taxa Selic, hoje em 13,75% ao ano, e que os juros serão mantidos em níveis restritivos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O diretor de Assuntos Internacionais e de Gestão de Riscos Corporativos do Banco Central, Paulo Picchetti, reforçou nesta quinta-feira que a instituição faz atualmente uma "calibração" da taxa Selic, hoje em 13,75% ao ano, e que os juros serão mantidos em níveis restritivos. "As taxas ainda estão e vão ser mantidas em patamares restritivos para atender nosso compromisso de conduzir a inflação para a meta", afirmou Picchetti, que atualmente acumula a Diretoria de Política Econômica do BC. Em entrevista coletiva à imprensa para comentar o mais recente Relatório de Política Monetária do BC, Picchetti afirmou ainda que, no horizonte relevante para a política monetária do BC, não há evidências de consolidação fiscal no Brasil. Ao avaliar o mercado de trabalho, o diretor do BC avaliou que ele segue resiliente. Já o crédito segue crescendo, conforme Picchetti, mas com desaceleração das concessões como resultado da política monetária. Também presente na entrevista, o presidente do BC, Gabriel Galípolo, disse que a autoridade monetária está lidando com os dados econômicos com "humildade", dado o nível inusual de incerteza que cerca as perspectivas econômicas. O BC, segundo ele, precisa evitar contar com um senso falso de precisão, inclusive ao avaliar se sua projeção de inflação de 3,1% a partir do segundo trimestre de 2028 constitui uma convergência à meta de 3%. Ainda assim, ele afirmou que os sinais de desaceleração da economia são crescentemente evidentes.

item.title: New York lawsuit says Polymarket's prediction markets are illegal gambling
item.description: New York's attorney general sued Polymarket on Thursday, escalating her battle against prediction markets, an industry that she says violates state laws against illegal gambling.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: New York's attorney general sued Polymarket on Thursday, escalating her battle against prediction markets, an industry that she says violates state laws against illegal gambling. Attorney General Letitia James filed her petition in a state court in Manhattan, two months after bringing a [USN:L6N43X096 TEXT:"similar case"] against rival Kalshi, and five months after filing [USN:L6N41415D TEXT:"similar petitions"] against two other prediction market operators, Coinbase Financial Markets (COIN.O) and Gemini Titan (GEMI.O) . All were accused of operating without obtaining required licenses from the New York State Gaming Commission. They were also accused of encouraging problem gambling, particularly among people under age 21, and endangering people's financial, emotional and physical health. “By running an unlicensed gambling operation, Polymarket has done more than just knowingly violate state law, they have put New Yorkers at risk, especially those underage who are most vulnerable to problem gaming," New York Governor Kathy Hochul said in a statement. New York is seeking civil fines, the forfeiture of illegal gains, and full restitution to customers. Prediction markets are best known for letting people wager through so-called event contracts on the outcomes of sports, though people can also wager on elections and cultural events such as the Oscars. Polymarket expressed disappointment that state officials decided to sue. "We chose to engage with them directly on the substance and address their concerns," Chief Legal Officer Neal Kumar said in a statement. "They preferred the media hit. Any time the (attorney general's) office wants to swing by, our door is open for a conversation about how we protect consumers and offer fair, transparent and legal markets." TRUMP'S SON BACKS POLYMARKET The case against Polymarket is the latest effort by US states to crack down on an industry that has soared in popularity since faring better than pollsters in predicting that Republican Donald Trump would beat Democrat Kamala Harris in the 2024 presidential election. Those states are also at odds with the Trump administration, with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission claiming exclusive authority to regulate prediction markets. Federal appeals courts are [USN:L6N44P0XA TEXT:"divided"] over who should oversee the industry, raising the prospect the US Supreme Court may need to decide. Founded in 2020, Polymarket bills itself as "the world's largest prediction market." It was out of the US market for more than three years, but relaunched last December following a [USN:L4N3UQ190 TEXT:"green light"] three months earlier from the CFTC. Polymarket also gained an [USN:L4N3UI15F TEXT:"investment"] last year from 1789 Capital, a venture capital firm backed by the president's oldest son, Donald Trump Jr. He is a partner there and a Polymarket adviser. New York said the value of Polymarket's business reportedly exceeds $20 billion. James views prediction markets as "quintessentially gambling" because they let people wager on events whose outcomes they don't control, and expect payouts if they win. Thursday's petition included several recent examples at Polymarket, including whether the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team would defeat the New York Mets on July 24, 2026 by more than 1.5 runs. The Dodgers won, 4-2. New York also objected to Polymarket's letting 18- to 20-year-olds use its platform, despite a minimum age of 21 under state law for mobile sports betting. By allowing gambling without state oversight, Polymarket is "exposing New Yorkers to gambling addiction with few, if any, safeguards," James said in the petition.

item.title: Russia likely to intensify hybrid attacks against NATO, Denmark warns
item.description: Denmark’s defence intelligence said Russia could carry out more frequent attacks against NATO, including sabotage, cyberattacks and limited strikes, in the coming months.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:

Russia likely to intensify hybrid attacks against NATO, Denmark warns

Denmark’s defence intelligence said Russia could carry out more frequent attacks against NATO, including sabotage, cyberattacks and limited strikes, in the coming months.

Reuters

24 September, 2026 07:55 pm IST

Russia is likely to intensify its hybrid war against the West in the coming months, Denmark’s defence intelligence service said in a new threat assessment on Thursday.

Hybrid warfare and sabotage on European soil gained renewed attention after Germany recently blamed Russia for an attempted drone attack at the Leipzig/Halle Airport, prompting European Union members to call for new sanctions against Russia.

Moscow has repeatedly denied any involvement in hybrid warfare, sabotage operations in NATO countries, or plotting any confrontation.

Show Full Article

The Russian embassy to Denmark did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

MORE FREQUENT ATTACKS EXPECTED

The defence intelligence service said Russia will carry out more frequent attacks against the West and NATO “with greater consequences for the countries targeted than in the past.”

It added that there was “a low but growing risk” that Russia would launch a limited military attack against one or several NATO countries that border Russia.

“A limited military attack would be a desperate move on Russia’s part and, like the intensified hybrid attacks, could potentially take place in the coming months,” it said.

Such attacks could include isolated strikes with long-range weapons like drones or missiles on infrastructure supporting Ukraine, or false-flag operations using Ukrainian-made drones, intelligence service chief Thomas Ahrenkiel said at a press conference.

He said Russia could also deploy a limited number of troops into a NATO border area, potentially under the pretext of protecting Russian minorities.

“The aim is not to take over the country, but to divide NATO,” he said.

A Russian frigate last week fired two flares towards a Danish military helicopter sent to photograph it in international waters off Denmark, with one narrowly missing the aircraft, according to the Danish military.

In a separate statement on Thursday, the Danish Resilience Agency said it was likely that Russia would attempt to carry out destructive cyberattacks against Denmark and it raised its threat level.

item.title: 米中首脳が会談、トランプ氏「米中関係に誇り」 習氏は台湾問題に言及
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt David Brunnstrom
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席をホワイトハウスに迎え、首脳会談を行った。習主席のワシントン訪問は１０年超ぶり。トランプ氏は会談後、記者団に対し「素晴らしい会談」だったと述べた。

米中首脳会談は今年２回目。人工知能（ＡＩ）、貿易、台湾、イランとの戦争を巡る問題など多くの懸案を抱える中でも、両首脳は安定した関係を内外に示すことに重点を置いており、今回の会談は象徴的な意味合いが強く、具体的な成果は限られる可能性があるとの見方も出ている。

会談後に中国国営新華社が公表した会談内容によると、習主席は台湾問題に言及。中国の核心的利益に関わる重要課題との認識を示し、米国に対して「台湾独立」に反対する立場を堅持するよう求め、台湾問題を慎重に扱うことを期待していると述べた。このほか中東問題については、米国とイランが戦闘終結とホルムズ海峡の再開を目的とした６月に成立した合意への復帰を支持すると表明した。

ホワイトハウスは現時点で会談内容を公表していない。

習主席は２３日に首都ワシントンに到着。郊外のアンドルーズ空軍基地でトランプ大統領自ら出迎えた。この日は午前に夫人の彭麗媛氏とともにホワイトハウスに到着し、トランプ氏とメラニア夫人の出迎えを受けた。

トランプ大統領は会談に先立ち、習氏との間に「真に素晴らしい友情関係」を築いてきたとし、「米中関係を誇りに思う」と語った。また、５月の自身の訪中以降、両国が貿易分野で大きな進展を遂げたとの認識を示した。

さらに会談で「安全保障、技術、『スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能）』に関する喫緊の課題について協議する」と述べ、「今日これらの分野で下す決定は、今後何十年にもわたり平和と繁栄を促進することになるだろう」と述べた。トランプ氏は２２日に行った国連総会の演説で、人工知能（ＡＩ）について今後は「スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能）」との呼称を用いる考えを示していた。

これに対し習氏は、友好関係の継続、協力の拡大、米中両国民の幸福促進が今回の訪米の目的だとし、「中国と米国の協力で全ての世界的な課題を解決できるわけではないが、両国の協力なしに多くの問題を解決することは難しい」とし、自身とトランプ大統領は互いを尊重し、定期的に意思疎通を図り、外交、貿易、金融、法執行分野での協力を支持していると述べた。

その上で、米中間の競争は「健全なものであるべきだ」とした上で、中国の門戸は開かれており、米企業の投資を歓迎すると表明。「米国においても中国企業が公正に扱われることを望む」と語った。

このほか、違法薬物対策で米国との協力を強化する用意があると表明。ＡＩについては、両国にはＡＩを適切に発展かつ管理する「能力と責任がある」との認識を示した。また、危機管理能力の向上に向け、両国軍が定期的な対話を維持すべきとの考えも示した。

習氏はこのほか、数日中にパンダ２頭が米南部ジョージア州のアトランタ動物園に到着すると明らかにした。また、今後５年間で１０万人の米国の若者を中国に招き、交流や留学の機会を提供する計画を明らかにした。

首脳会談に先立ち、両首脳はホワイトハウスのローズガーデンで行われた軍事式典に臨んだ。式典では上空を航空機が編隊飛行し、ホワイトハウスの大統領執務室の屋上には米国旗とともに中国国旗が掲げられた。

item.title: ECBシュナーベル理事、IMF上級職に－任期満了待たず来年1月就任へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のシュナーベル専務理事（55）が任期満了を待たずに退任し、国際通貨基金（IMF）の上級職に就く見通しとなった。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

関係者らによると、ドイツ出身のシュナーベル氏はIMFの金融資本市場局長に選ばれた。関係者の1人によると、就任は1月の予定で、シュナーベル氏は来年12月に満了する8年間のECB理事としての任期を、大幅に前倒しして退任することになる。

シュナーベル氏が任期途中で退任すれば、来年予定されていたECBの幹部人事の刷新が一段と急務になる。ラガルド総裁とチーフエコノミストのレーン理事も、来年任期満了を迎える。

欧州連合（EU）首脳は、3つのポストの人事について一括の合意を目指しており、12月のEU首脳会議で協議する可能性がある。フランスとドイツがECB理事職で自国出身者のポストを維持しようとする一方、スペインもデギンドス前副総裁が今年退任したことを受け、理事のポスト獲得を狙っている。

ラガルド氏も、早期退任の可能性が取り沙汰されている。ラガルド氏は、世界経済フォーラム（WEF）からトップ就任を打診されており、関心を示している。ラガルド氏は先週、2027年にECBを退任すると述べたが、同年10月の任期満了まで務めるかどうかは明らかにしなかった。

総裁の後任には、オランダ中銀のクノット前総裁とスペイン中銀のデコス前総裁が有力候補とされる。デコス氏については、サンチェス首相が23日のブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで、支持を表明した。

シュナーベル氏は、次期総裁を務める用意があると述べたこともあったが、有力候補に挙げられることはなかった。理由の一つは、同氏が現在のECBで最もタカ派的な当局者となっていることだ。

シュナーベル氏は、イラン戦争勃発後に実施された2回の利上げを明確に支持してきた。さらなる金融引き締めが必要になる可能性を示唆し、最近のエネルギー価格上昇についても「かなり懸念すべきだ」と述べていた。

item.title: Trump offre à Xi un accueil d'exception à la Maison blanche, peu d'avancées attendues
item.description: Donald Trump a réservé jeudi à Xi Jinping un accueil d'exception à la Maison blanche, dans le cadre d'une visite d'Etat de trois jours du président chinois, lors de laquelle aucune avancée majeure n'est attendue alors que priorité est donnée à la stabilité des liens, malgré une profonde rivalité sous-jacente.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
item.content:encoded: Donald Trump a réservé jeudi à Xi Jinping un accueil d'exception à la Maison blanche, dans le cadre d'une visite d'Etat de trois jours du président chinois, lors de laquelle aucune avancée majeure n'est attendue alors que priorité est donnée à la stabilité des liens, malgré une profonde rivalité sous-jacente. Plusieurs sujets épineux, dont l'intelligence artificielle (IA), le commerce, Taïwan et la guerre en Iran, sont sources de tensions dans les relations bilatérales, même si Donald Trump, comme il l'a régulièrement fait par le passé, a mis en avant jeudi sa très bonne relation personnelle avec Xi Jinping. Les deux dirigeants ont eu une "excellente réunion" à la Maison blanche, en début d'après-midi, a déclaré le président américain aux journalistes alors qu'il accompagnait son homologue chinois vers l'hélicoptère présidentiel avant son départ des lieux. En parallèle, l'agence de presse officielle Chine nouvelle a rapporté que la question de Taïwan a été évoquée durant la réunion, Xi Jinping exhortant Donald Trump à modifier la position de Washington pour s'opposer à l'indépendance de l'île démocratique, considérée par Pékin comme une province renégate. Aucun compte-rendu n'a été effectué dans l'immédiat par la Maison blanche. Il était attendu que Xi Jinping presse Donald Trump de suspendre les livraisons d'armes à Taïwan. A l'issue de sa visite en Chine en mai dernier, le président américain avait dit garder comme "monnaie d'échange" une livraison d'armes record de 14 milliards de dollars pour Taipei approuvée par le Pentagone mais pas encore par ses soins. Cette décision a alimenté les préoccupations d'alliés de Washington en Asie et de certains soutiens républicains de Donald Trump, qui craignent que le président américain décide de revoir à la baisse le soutien des Etats-Unis à Taïwan afin d'obtenir de Pékin des victoires commerciales. S'exprimant à Pékin lors d'un point de presse régulier, un porte-parole du ministère chinois de la Défense a déclaré que Washington devait faire preuve d'une "extrême prudence" au sujet des ventes d'armes à Taïwan, appelant à des relations militaires sino-américaines stables, saines et durables. "INTERETS VITAUX" C'est encadrés par des soldats portant des drapeaux des deux pays, par une fanfare et aux côtés de leurs épouses que Donald Trump et Xi Jinping ont échangé sourires et poignées de mains, sur un tapis rouge devant la Maison blanche, peu après 16h00 GMT, avant d'entrer dans le bâtiment. "Dès ma première élection en 2016, le président Xi et moi avons noué une amitié, une très grande amitié même, fondée sur le respect mutuel et les intérêts vitaux de nos peuples", a ensuite déclaré Donald Trump,indiquant que la réunion entre les deux dirigeants porterait sur la sécurité, les technologies et l'intelligence artificielle (IA). "Les décisions que nous prenons aujourd'hui dans ces domaines peuvent favoriser la paix et la prospérité pendant des décennies", a-t-il ajouté. Xi Jinping a pour sa part évoqué "une relation personnelle de confiance" avec le locataire de la Maison blanche. "Comme je l'ai dit à maintes reprises, la Chine et les États-Unis, en tant que deux grandes puissances, ont tout à gagner à coopérer et tout à perdre dans un affrontement", a-t-il dit, appelant à une concurrence "saine" mais "limitée" entre les deux pays. Le président chinois, qui souhaite "un dialogue régulier" entre les armées des deux pays, mais aussi améliorer "les mécanismes de communication et de prévention des crises", a également annoncé que la Chine inviterait "100.000 jeunes Américains" au cours des cinq prochaines années dans le cadre d'études et d'échanges, ainsi que l'accueil de deux pandas géants par le zoo d'Atlanta. Donald Trump entend être à la hauteur de l'accueil grandiose qu'il a reçu en Chine en mai dernier, avec une cérémonie organisée sur la pelouse sud de la Maison blanche ainsi que dans les salles de réception et la Roseraie. Un grand dîner d'État en présence de plusieurs grands dirigeants de la "tech" américaine était prévu jeudi. Il s'agit de la deuxième rencontre cette année entre les dirigeants des deux premières puissances économiques mondiales, mais de la première visite de Xi Jinping à Washington depuis plus d'une décennie. UNE "LIGNE DIRECTE" DÉDIÉE À L'IA ? Donald Trump avait accueilli mercredi le président chinois à sa descente d'avion, près de Washington. Il s'agissait du premier accueil d'un dirigeant étranger par un président américain sur la base militaire d'Andrews depuis la visite du pape François en 2015, alors reçu par Barack Obama, selon le réseau de chaînes câblées C-SPAN. Le secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent, a de son côté déclaré à la chaîne Fox News qu'il était convenu avec le vice-Premier ministre chinois, He Lifeng, de prolonger de deux mois - soit jusqu'au 10 janvier prochain - la trêve commerciale entre les deux pays qui devait expirer le 10 novembre. Dans un message publié jeudi matin sur son réseau Truth Social, Donald Trump a indiqué qu'il ne s'attendait à aucune décision substantielle en matière de "super intelligence" - l'expression qu'il emploie pour désigner l'IA. "La super intelligence sera un sujet majeur de discussion, mais je veux laisser les choses exactement en l'état", a-t-il écrit. "C'est également la position de la Chine." Le secrétaire d'État américain, Marco Rubio, avait précédemment déclaré qu'une réflexion naissante portait sur "l'équivalent d'une ligne directe telle que celle dont nous disposions pendant la Guerre froide" afin d'éviter des incidents qui "pourraient avoir un impact sur les économies ou les sociétés, voire conduire à un conflit entre États-nations". Globalement, aucune avancée majeure n'est attendue lors de la visite du président chinois, des désaccords subsistant entre Pékin et Washington sur de nombreux dossiers, dont les opioïdes et les terres rares. Les discussions pourraient néanmoins déboucher sur des accords visant à réduire les droits de douane dans certains secteurs, à coopérer dans la lutte contre le trafic de drogue et à élargir le dialogue entre les forces armées des deux pays. Donald Trump devrait en outre demander la libération d'Américains et d'autres personnes détenues en Chine.

item.title: 米新築住宅販売が予想上回る、今年の最高水準に－物件価格下落
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国の新築住宅販売件数は8月に増加し、今年に入ってからの最高水準となった。物件の値下げや販売促進策が、住宅購入の負担を和らげている状況が示唆された。

住宅販売価格の中央値は前年同月比5.8%下落して39万3700ドル（約6260万円）となった。下落率は2025年7月以来の大きさで、30万ドル未満の住宅で契約件数が増えたことを反映した。

8月の販売件数増加は、住宅建設業者が販売奨励策を活用して需要喚起を続けていることを映すが、持ち直しは長続きしない可能性がある。

住宅ローン金利は足元で7%を上回り、この2年余りの最高水準となった。物件価格は新型コロナ禍前の水準を依然として約20%上回っている。

住宅建設業者は、無料の設備アップグレードや住宅ローン金利の負担軽減といった販売促進策に大きく依存しており、値下げに踏み切る業者も増えている。

8月末で売りに出されていた新築物件は48万3000戸と前月比と変わらず、高止まりしているが、前年同月比では2%減少した。現在の販売ペースで見た場合、在庫消化に要する期間は8.5カ月となる。

地域別では、全米最大の住宅販売地域である南部で45万1000戸と、7%近く増加。昨年11月以来の高水準となった。中西部では約85%増と、大幅に増加。前月に落ち込んだ反動が見られた。西部と北東部では減少した。

原題：US New-Home Sales Rise to Fastest This Year as Prices Drop (3)（抜粋）

--取材協力：Laura Yin、Julia Fanzeres.

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請件数19.7万件、57年ぶり低水準近辺
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米労働省が２４日発表した９月１９日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請件数19.7万件、57年ぶり低水準近辺 9/24 23:13 配信

米ニューヨーク市マンハッタンで2021年9月撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２４日発表した９月１９日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１０００件減の１９万７０００件となった。労働市場が堅調さを増していることを示唆した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万１０００件だった。

申請件数は５７年ぶりの低水準近辺にあるが、これはレイバーデー（労働者の日）などの移動祝日を巡る季節調整の難しさが一因とされる。またエコノミストからは、年末に向けて申請件数を押し下げる傾向がある「残存季節性」と呼ばれる要因も指摘されている。

それでも、申請件数の根本的な傾向は、夏場の大半で低迷した後、低水準のレイオフ（一時解雇）を支えに持ち直した労働市場と整合的な内容となっている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「イランとの戦争が長引くにつれてエネルギー価格が再び上昇しており、経済はいつ需要面でソフトパッチ（一時的な停滞）に陥ってもおかしくない。時間との勝負と言えるかもしれない」と指摘。「しかし９月中旬の時点では、人工知能（ＡＩ）への巨額の設備投資を一因として経済はフル稼働しているようだ」と述べた。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１７５０件減の２０万２２５０件だった。

９月１２日までの週の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２０００件増の１７１万９０００件と、２０２３年以来の低水準近辺となった。シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「ここ数カ月安定してきた後、継続受給者数が低水準にとどまれば、今後数カ月で失業率が４％に近づく可能性がある」と指摘。「ただ、労働力人口の縮小に伴う失業率の低下が、必ずしも労働市場の再引き締まりを意味するわけではないという点には注意が必要だ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 アングル：試される米消費の持続力、物価高に政府閉鎖や雇用情勢悪化で 最終更新: 9/25(金) 0:25 ロイター

item.title: Fed officials see rates likely rising to curb high inflation
item.description: The U.S. central bank will likely need to raise interest rates again to curb unacceptably high inflation, two Federal Reserve policymakers said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: The U.S. central bank will likely need to raise interest rates again to curb unacceptably [USN:L6N45F0KH TEXT:"high inflation"], two Federal Reserve policymakers said on Thursday. "Returning inflation to 2% is a top priority, and I will support the policy path that gets us there while carefully weighing risks to the labor market along the way," Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson told a conference at her regional bank. Paulson, a voting member of the central bank's rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee, described inflation as "stubbornly elevated" and said "if conditions evolve as I expect, some modest further tightening may be warranted." Speaking in London, New York Fed President John Williams also suggested tighter monetary policy is coming. Citing Fed [USN:L6N45816B TEXT:"policymaker projections"] released last week that penciled in a rate increase, he said "it's likely that another rate hike may be appropriate by the end of the year. That seems to me a reasonable way of thinking about it." Paulson and Williams spoke just over a week after the Fed [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"raised"] its benchmark interest rate by a quarter of a percentage point, to the 3.75%-4.00% range, in an effort to curb high inflation that threatens to undermine public confidence in the central bank's ability to reach the 2% target. Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, in a terse post-meeting press conference, said "our predominant focus is on the price-stability side of our mandate. The plain fact is that inflation is too high and has been for too long." In contrast to the Fed projections for one more rate hike in 2026, futures markets are braced for significantly more increases. CLEAR FOCUS Fed officials who spoke on Thursday said the central bank does not have much of a balancing act when setting policy relative to its job and inflation mandates. Noting that the economy is strong, they said there is space to focus on the inflation problem. "Current conditions in the United States indicate that output is growing at a solid pace and the labor market remains close to my definition of maximum employment, but inflation remains elevated," Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said in comments opening a conference at her regional bank. "The inflation outlook continues to be highly uncertain, with risks tilted to the upside" and "the longer that high inflation persists, the more challenging and costly it can be to bring it back down," she said. Hammack, who has been one of the most vocal rate-hike proponents within the Fed, did not address the monetary policy outlook in her remarks. But she did explain that the persistence of inflation above 2% gives the central bank less space to shrug off what would normally be seen as transitory factors. Inflation, when measured by the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index, was [USN:L1N44N0KC TEXT:"3.7% in July"] on a year-over-year basis. It is in large part being driven by the aftershocks of President Donald Trump's trade tariffs and surging fuel costs resulting from the US-Israeli [USN:L1N45G0KO TEXT:"war with Iran"]. "When the environment is more prone to shocks, or the shocks arrive one after another in a period when inflation has been elevated for years, there's a greater risk that an inflationary mindset could take hold," Hammack said.

item.content:encoded:
Susan Heavey

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米メディアのＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）とＣＮＮは２４日、ホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを認められたと明らかにした。これに先立ち、同２社およびポリティコの記者らは、ワシントンの連邦地裁が同日、トランプ大統領による３社のホワイトハウス立ち入り禁止措置について、違憲の可能性が高いとして差し止めを命じていたにもかかわらず、立ち入りを拒否されていた。

item.title: クリーブランド連銀総裁、「インフレ心理定着のリスク高まる」
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米クリーブランド連銀のハマック総裁は米経済について、相次ぐ供給ショックに見舞われており、インフレ心理が定着するリスクが高まっているとの見解を示した。

ハマック氏は24日、同連銀が主催したイベントで「インフレ見通しは引き続き極めて不確実性が高く、リスクは上振れ方向に傾いている」と述べた。

「金融政策にとって特に困難なのは、このところショックが長期にわたって相次いでいることだ。関税や原油価格を通じた供給側のショックに加え、AI関連の設備投資ブームによる需要側のショックもある」と指摘。

「金融政策は供給ショックを一時的なものとしてやり過ごすべきだというのが、従来の考え方だ」とした上で、「ショックが起きやすい環境にある場合や、インフレが長年にわたって高止まりする中でショックが次々と生じる場合には、インフレ心理が定着するリスクが高まる」と語った。

ハマック氏はまた、「高インフレは長引けば長引くほど、それを元の水準に戻すことがより困難になり、代償も大きくなり得る」と述べた。

原題：Fed’s Hammack Says Shocks Increase Risk of Inflationary Mindset（抜粋）

item.title: 米インフレ高止まり、上振れリスク継続＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２４日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２４日、インフレ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米インフレ高止まり、上振れリスク継続＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 9/24 22:59 配信

８月２７日撮影　REUTERS/Ann Saphir

Michael S. Derby

[２４日　ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２４日、インフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引くほど、インフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。

ハマック総裁はクリーブランド地区連銀で開かれた会議の冒頭で「米経済は現在、堅調なペースで成長しており、労働市場も自身が最大雇用と見なす状態に近い。ただ、インフレ率は依然として高止まりしている」と述べた。

その上で「インフレ見通しを巡る不確実性は引き続き非常に高く、リスクは上振れ方向に傾いている」と指摘。「高インフレが長期化するほど、インフレ率を再び低下させるための対応は一段と困難になり、そのコストも大きくなる」と語った。

ハマック総裁は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持っている。

Google plans first test of AI chips in space under Project Suncatcher

FILE PHOTO: Google logo is displayed at Google's headquarters in New York City, U.S., July 1, 2026. REUTERS/Aleksandra Michalska/File Photo

FAST

Sept 24 : Alphabet's Google said on Thursday it will launch a prototype satellite next week in its first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher, a research effort to explore whether space could potentially host large-scale AI computing infrastructure. Companies including SpaceX and Starcloud are pursuing plans to deploy data centers in low Earth orbit, aiming to harness near-continuous sunlight to power energy-intensive AI computing and sidestep terrestrial constraints on electricity supplies. The new mission, scheduled to fly on SpaceX's upcoming Transporter-18 rideshare launch in partnership with satellite company Planet Labs, will assess how Google's AI hardware withstands launch forces, radiation and extreme temperatures in LEO. After the launch, it will send a prototype satellite carrying Google Tensor Processing Units into low Earth orbit to assess if the AI chips can operate reliably in space.

Space radiation can disrupt or degrade electronics, including by causing data errors known as bit flips. Google said it tested its TPUs while running AI workloads in a facility at the University of California, Davis, but that orbital testing was needed to understand how the hardware performs in the real environment. The company will also evaluate its design to cool the power-intensive chips in the vacuum of space, where conventional airflow cooling is impossible, by combining heat pipes with radiators. But experts have said that the concept remains years from being commercially viable given high launch costs, engineering constraints and satellite production bottlenecks. The first Suncatcher mission is designed to gather in-orbit data and identify potential failure points, rather than demonstrate an operational orbital data center, Google said. It aims to launch two satellites in 2027 to test the high-bandwidth laser links needed to connect future computing clusters.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米経常赤字、第2四半期は2460億ドルに拡大 モノの輸入急増
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した第２・四半期の経常収支の赤字額は、前期比３３４億ドル（１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米経常赤字、第2四半期は2460億ドルに拡大　モノの輸入急増 9/24 22:53 配信

米カリフォルニア州のロサンゼルス港で３月撮影。REUTERS/Caroline Brehman

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した第２・四半期の経常収支の赤字額は、前期比３３４億ドル（１５．７％）増の２４６０億ドルとなった。財（モノ）の輸入急増を背景に大きく拡大した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト調査では、経常赤字は２５５０億ドルに拡大すると予想されていた。

第１・四半期の赤字額は、従来の推計値２２６８億ドルから２１２６億ドルに下方改定された。

第２・四半期の経常赤字は国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３．０％で、第１・四半期の２．７％から拡大した。ドルは基軸通貨としての地位を持つため経常赤字自体がドル相場に与える影響はないものの、米国の「双子の赤字」膨張に対する懸念が強まっている。

第２・四半期のモノの輸入は６７４億ドル増の９３１６億ドルに急増。モノの輸出の２７１億ドル増（６４０３億ドル）を大きく上回った。この結果、モノの貿易赤字は４０４億ドル拡大し、２９１３億ドルとなった。貿易は第２・四半期のＧＤＰを１．１４％ポイント押し下げ、３四半期連続でマイナス寄与となった。

第１次所得収支は１１４億ドルの黒字と、前期の１５８億ドルから縮小した。第１次所得の受取額は４１６２億ドルと、前期の３９１５億ドルから増加。支払額は４２７６億ドルと前期の４０７３億ドルから増加した。

純国際投資ポジション（ＮＩＩＰ）はマイナス２２兆４２００億ドルと前期のマイナス２１兆２７００億ドルからやや悪化した。対外資産は４６兆９７００億ドル、対外負債は６９兆３９００億ドルとなった。

Morgan Stanley Asia deals leaked in missent email attachment

A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia leaked the deals by accident via an email he sent to clients.

FAST

HONG KONG: A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia accidentally leaked their deal pipeline in an email sent to clients, according to six people with knowledge of the matter. The banker attached the financial sponsors group's deal pipeline by mistake in a weekly update email he sent to clients, the people said. "Morgan Stanley takes client confidentiality extremely seriously. We promptly took steps to address this inadvertent sharing of information and we continue to engage with relevant parties," a spokesperson for the Wall Street bank said in an emailed response to Reuters on Thursday (Sep 24). The banker later retracted the email and apologised for the mishap, urging recipients to delete copies of the attachment and refrain from circulating the document, according to a screenshot of the email seen by Reuters.

The list, dated Sep 21, contained about 60 live IPO, M&A and block trade deals across Greater China, South Korea, Southeast Asia, India and the EMEA region. It also included over 50 deals that were categorised as "pitching", and nearly 30 deals categorised as "on hold". All of those deals concern Asian companies. The vast majority of the companies on the list are portfolios of major global and regional private equity and venture capital firms. Bloomberg first reported on the incident late on Wednesday. The list did not contain details of any of the deals, and a lot of them have already been reported, according to some people who received the email.

Source: Reuters/rk

item.title: UN says Yemen violence struck camps and health centres
item.description: Displacement camps and health centres have been attacked during surging violence in Yemen between Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces and Iran-backed Houthis, UN agencies said on Thursday, deploring a growing civilian death toll which includes children.
item.dc:creator: Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: Displacement camps and health centres have been attacked during [USN:L1N45G08F TEXT:"surging violence"] in Yemen between Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces and Iran-backed Houthis, UN agencies said on Thursday, deploring a growing civilian death toll which includes children. The latest fighting marks a sharp escalation in Yemen's civil war, which had largely been frozen since a 2022 truce, as well as a widening of the conflict that has grown out of the US-Israeli war on Iran. Violence has flared along old front lines in recent weeks, including around Taiz as the Houthis [USN:L1N45D0B1 TEXT:"swept south"] along the Red Sea coast, prompting a [USN:L6N45E0CP TEXT:"humanitarian crisis "]with over 130,000 people displaced and some [USN:L6N45A0K6 TEXT:"fleeing to Africa across the Red Sea"]. UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk said his office had documented three attacks by Ansar Allah, the formal name for the Houthi movement, on sites for internally displaced people since August. He said these attacks on August 7, September 7 and September 9 in the Marib region caused dozens of casualties and killed five children. Overall, Turk's office has documented the killing of 32 civilians, including 15 children and 3 women, since August in fighting, including drone and missile strikes. They were among 125 people killed or wounded in the latest flareup in the conflict - a figure his office said was likely an undercount due to access constraints and insecurity. "Civilians are now bearing the brunt of this latest upsurge in fighting," Turk said in a statement. The World Health Organization said some health facilities had been "directly attacked" and an ambulance driver and a medic were killed in Lahj on September 18, without attributing blame. INFLUX OF DISPLACED CAUSES NEW ACUTE AID SHORTAGES Both sides allege that hundreds have been killed in fighting over the past weeks, without providing details. Houthi spokesperson Mohammed Abdulsalam said the UN human rights office was no longer impartial and that its allegations were false, accusing it of ignoring what he described as Saudi bombardment in Yemen that had targeted public facilities including a correctional facility and homes and schools. More than 70 UN staff are being detained by Houthis in Yemen, some of whom have been held for many years. Turk called for their release and urged all the warring parties to protect civilians, saying the government warnings of attacks did not remove the protections they should have. Saudi officials have repeatedly said the country's forces do not target civilians in Yemen. Saudi officials did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Aid groups are [USN:L1N45D0P8 TEXT:"ramping up"] their response to the crisis in a country where 18 million people, or roughly half the population face acute food insecurity. The World Health Organization has stepped up distribution of medical supplies, including blood bags as well as trauma and surgery kits, and is deploying emergency teams as injuries rise, the statement said. But many people lack support and a UN refugee agency plan for Yemen was less than 20% funded before the renewed violence caused a surge in needs. An internally displaced mother of four, Aisha Ahmed, told Reuters in the Taiz camp that the influx of people in recent weeks is causing shortages. "We need water and everything else, we have nothing," she said.

item.title: Solicitudes de subsidio por desempleo en EE.UU. caen a una de sus cifras más bajas desde 1969
item.description: Las solicitudes iniciales bajaron en 1.000 durante la semana terminada el 19 de septiembre, mientras las solicitudes continuas se mantuvieron en 1,72 millones.
item.dc:creator: Julia Fanzeres
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Las solicitudes de subsidio por desempleo en Estados Unidos cayeron la semana pasada al nivel más bajo desde julio, lo que sugiere que los despidos siguen siendo poco frecuentes en un mercado laboral generalmente estable. Las solicitudes iniciales de subsidio por desempleo disminuyeron en 1.000, hasta situarse en 197.000, durante la semana que finalizó el 19 de septiembre, según datos del Departamento de Trabajo publicados el jueves. Se trata de una de las cifras más bajas desde 1969. Las solicitudes continuas de prestaciones por desempleo, un indicador del número de personas que reciben ayudas, se mantuvieron prácticamente sin cambios en 1,72 millones en la semana que finalizó el 12 de septiembre, cerca del nivel más bajo desde 2023. Las solicitudes iniciales de subsidio por desempleo se han mantenido cerca de mínimos históricos durante los últimos meses, debido a la reticencia de las empresas a despedir trabajadores. Al mismo tiempo, la contratación ha sido irregular, lo que limita las oportunidades para los estadounidenses que se sienten atrapados en sus empleos o marginados. Ver más: Solicitudes de subsidio por desempleo en EE.UU. caen a su nivel más bajo desde julio El promedio móvil de cuatro semanas de nuevas solicitudes, una métrica que ayuda a suavizar la volatilidad, descendió a 202.250, el nivel más bajo en seis semanas. Antes de ajustar por factores estacionales, las solicitudes iniciales aumentaron. Este aumento se debió principalmente a los incrementos en California, Hawái y Nueva York. Las solicitudes iniciales de subsidio por desempleo se mantuvieron excepcionalmente bajas a mediados de septiembre, lo que indica una estabilidad en el mercado laboral. Los pocos sectores que están despidiendo trabajadores parecen estar centrados en mejorar la eficiencia, y aún no se observan indicios de que las tasas de interés más altas estén provocando despidos, ni siquiera en los sectores más sensibles a las fluctuaciones de las tasas. — Eliza Winger. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事退任へ、ＩＭＦ転出 理事会人事の再編始動
item.description: [フランクフルト ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は２４日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事退任へ、ＩＭＦ転出　理事会人事の再編始動 9/24 21:58 配信

シュナーベルECB理事、6月30日撮影 REUTERS/Pedro Rocha/File Photo

[フランクフルト ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は２４日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の幹部ポストに就任するため退任すると発表した。ＥＣＢ理事会の大規模な人事再編が始動することになる。

シュナーベル氏は８年の任期満了を１年前倒しし、来年１月３日付で退任する。その後は、ＩＭＦの市場局長に就任する予定で、同ポストは８月３１日に退任したエードリアン氏の後任となる。

ＥＣＢは声明で「理事会はクーリングオフ期間を設けないことを決定した」と説明。「シュナーベル氏はＥＣＢでの残任期間中、ＩＭＦに関連するいかなる事項にも関与しない」と述べた。

シュナーベル氏の退任により、複雑な政治的駆け引きが始まることになる。ＥＣＢのレーン主任エコノミストは２０２７年５月に退任予定であるほか、ラガルド総裁も遅くとも２７年１０月までに退任する見通しだ。

シュナーベル氏の後任人事はより広範な政治的取引の一部となる公算が大きい。ドイツ、スペイン、オランダ、フランスがそれぞれ有力な理事ポストを狙って綱引きを繰り広げているためだ。

制度上はどの国もシュナーベル氏の後任を争えるが、ユーロ圏３大国であるドイツ、フランス、イタリアが事実上、理事会の常任議席を確保している。

ただ、ドイツが単にシュナーベル氏の後任に別のドイツ人候補を充てるだけであれば、ラガルド氏の退任後の総裁ポストを争わないことを意味する。このため、事情に詳しい関係筋は、シュナーベル氏のポストを巡る駆け引きにはＥＣＢの他の２ポストも絡む可能性が高いと指摘している。

スペインは国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のエルナンデス・デ・コス総支配人を次期ＥＣＢ総裁に指名すべくロビー活動を展開しており、オランダは前中央銀行総裁のクノット氏を推している。ドイツはブンデスバンク（連邦銀行）のナーゲル総裁を総裁候補として検討していたが、最近はその意向が弱まっているとみられ、別のポストを狙う可能性もある。

一方、既にトリシェ氏とラガルド氏の２人のＥＣＢ総裁を輩出してきたフランスは、主任エコノミストのポスト獲得を目指しているという。

item.title: Schnabel del BCE dimite para unirse al FMI; comienza reorganización del Consejo
item.description: Isabel Schnabel, miembro del Consejo de Gobierno del Banco Central Europeo, dimitió el jueves para asumir un cargo de alto nivel en el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI), lo que ha dado inicio a una larga reorganización de la cúpula de la institución financiera más poderosa de Europa.
item.dc:creator: Balazs Koranyi, Francesco Canepa
item.content:encoded: Isabel Schnabel, miembro del Consejo de Gobierno del Banco Central Europeo, dimitió el jueves para asumir un cargo de alto nivel en el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI), lo que ha dado inicio a una larga reorganización de la cúpula de la institución financiera más poderosa de Europa. Schnabel, alemana y responsable de operaciones de mercado del BCE, dejará su cargo con efecto a partir del 3 de enero —un año antes de que expire su mandato de ocho años— para convertirse en la nueva directora del departamento de mercados del FMI, un puesto que quedó vacante tras la salida de Tobias Adrian el 31 de agosto. "El Consejo de Gobierno ha decidido que no es necesario un período de espera", indicó el BCE en un comunicado. "La señora Schnabel no participará en ningún asunto relacionado con el FMI durante el resto de su mandato en el BCE". La dimisión de Schnabel pone en marcha lo que probablemente será una complicada partida de ajedrez político por los codiciados puestos, ya que el economista jefe del BCE, Philip Lane, tiene previsto marcharse el próximo mayo y la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde —ella misma objeto de persistentes rumores de dimisión— abandonará el cargo a más tardar el próximo octubre. Esto sugiere que la sustitución de Schnabel será parte de un acuerdo político más amplio, más que de un nombramiento aislado, ya que Alemania, España, los Países Bajos y Francia compiten por puestos de poder en el consejo. Sin embargo, es poco probable que la renovación en la cúpula del banco tenga un impacto significativo en la política monetaria a corto plazo, ya que la mayoría de los que compiten por los puestos más altos llevan años vinculados al banco. Por eso los mercados siguen esperando que el BCE continúe subiendo las tasas de interés para combatir el repunte de la inflación, y se prevé un alza, muy probablemente, en diciembre. Aunque, técnicamente, cualquier país puede disputar el puesto de Schnabel, los tres principales del bloque —Alemania, Francia e Italia— cuentan con un puesto permanente de facto en el consejo de administración. Sin embargo, si Alemania se limitara a sustituir a Schnabel por otro candidato, ello significaría que Berlín está renunciando, en esencia, a disputar el puesto de Lagarde. Por eso, fuentes cercanas al asunto dicen que es probable que cualquier acuerdo sobre la sustitución de Schnabel afecte también a los otros dos puestos. España está presionando para que el director general del Banco de Pagos Internacionales, Pablo Hernández de Cos, se convierta en el próximo presidente del BCE, mientras que los Países Bajos apuestan por Klaas Knot, su antiguo gobernador del banco central. Alemania barajaba al presidente del Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, para la presidencia, pero su compromiso parece haberse debilitado recientemente y podría optar por otro cargo. A este ajedrez político se suma el hecho de que el nombramiento de Knot probablemente obligaría a Frank Elderson, otro neerlandés, a dimitir del consejo, según la costumbre. Eso dejaría vacante un cuarto puesto en el consejo, lo que significaría que dos tercios del consejo del BCE serían sustituidos en rápida sucesión. Por su parte, Francia, que ya ha aportado al BCE dos presidentes —Lagarde y Jean-Claude Trichet—, espera hacerse con el puesto de economista jefe, habían dicho antes fuentes.

FAST

Sept 24 : The transfer window may be closed but for clubs still looking to strengthen their squad or replace long-term absentees there are plenty of high-profile players out of contract, with Udinese signing former Real Madrid defender David Alaba on Thursday. Alaba, a four-times Champions League winner who lifted 10 Bundesliga titles with Bayern Munich and two LaLiga crowns at Real, captained Austria at this year's World Cup but the 34-year-old has spent much of the last few years on the sidelines. An anterior cruciate ligament rupture in his left knee in December 2023 put Alaba out for over a year, and the centre back has had numerous injury setbacks since his return. His five-year contract with Real expired at the end of last season. Serie A side Udinese have lost their last three games and are desperate to shore up the defence, having failed to keep a clean sheet in their opening five league matches, conceding 11 goals. Alaba has signed until the end of the season.

Another 34-year-old defender left Real Madrid at the end of last season when Dani Carvajal brought down the curtain on a hugely successful 13-year spell at the club where he won the Champions League six times, along with four league titles. Like Alaba, Carvajal has struggled with injuries in the last two seasons and the Euro 2024 winner was left out of Spain's World Cup squad, but media reports have linked him with a move to the Premier League. SANCHO'S EUROPEAN CREDENTIALS England forward Jadon Sancho, meanwhile, is likely to move away from the Premier League, after the 26-year-old's five-year contract with Manchester United came ended in June. Sancho joined United from Dortmund for 85 million euros ($96.65 million) in 2021, but struggled for a regular place before falling out with manager Erik ten Hag who criticised his performances in training. That led to a number of loan spells including a return to Dortmund along with time at Chelsea and Aston Villa, none of which brought a permanent move. For a club looking to go deep in European competition, Sancho could prove a decent option. He has reached the final of three different European cups with three different clubs in the last three seasons. A Champions League final loss with Dortmund was followed by a Conference League final win with Chelsea, when Sancho scored in the final, and last season he came off the bench in Villa's Europa League final triumph over Freiburg. A former Ballon d'Or winner is also available, after 38-year-old French forward Karim Benzema left Saudi club Al-Hilal by mutual consent at the end of August, with compatriot Paul Pogba also out of contract after parting ways with AS Monaco. Former Manchester United and Juventus midfielder and World Cup winner Pogba spent over two years out of action following a doping ban and his fitness problems since returning to the pitch in November led to Monaco terminating his contract in August. Other notable names looking for a club include Algerian winger Riyad Mahrez, a Premier League winner with Leicester City and Manchester City, former Inter Milan and Paris St Germain striker Mauro Icardi plus Italian defenders Francesco Acerbi and Matteo Darmian. ($1 = 0.8794 euros)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Oracle cites 'force majeure' to shield itself on data center, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Sept 24 : Oracle is seeking to protect itself from potential cost increases related to a large data center project in New Mexico by sending a "force majeure" notice to the project's developer, a unit of Blue Owl, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday.Shares of the company fell around 5 per cent in trading after
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Oracle cites 'force majeure' to shield itself on data center, Bloomberg News reports

Oracle logo is seen in this illustration created on September 9, 2025. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Sept 24 : Oracle is seeking to protect itself from potential cost increases related to a large data center project in New Mexico by sending a "force majeure" notice to the project's developer, a unit of Blue Owl, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday. Shares of the company fell around 5 per cent in trading after the report, which cited sources familiar with the matter. Reuters could not independently verify the news. Rather than exiting as the main tenant, Oracle is attempting to delay payments should the data center dubbed Project Jupiter get derailed and fail to come online in 2028 as planned, according to the report. Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their control, a move that can raise concerns among lenders and investors.

"Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule," Oracle said in response to a Reuters inquiry. "Force-majeure notices are commonplace in developments of this scale and are often used to preserve contractual rights among project partners. They do not, by themselves, establish a project delay or change delivery expectations," Oracle added. Alternative asset manager Blue Owl, which owns the data-center developer Stack Infrastructure, said the notice does not change the financial commitments to this multi-year project. The 1,400-acre Project Jupiter campus, which secured $18 billion in loans from a consortium of banks, according to media reports, is part of Oracle's broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity. The New Mexico data center campus has reportedly faced multiple infrastructure setbacks, including delays to a planned natural-gas pipeline and legal challenges over water and air-quality permits. The project is a part of Stargate, an initiative to build AI infrastructure in the US under a $500 billion investment commitment involving OpenAI, SoftBank Group and partners including Oracle. The massive AI infrastructure build-out has faced mounting challenges, as developers race to secure power, water and other resources while managing the massive costs of deploying computing capacity for partners such as OpenAI. Growing opposition from the public has made data centers a political flashpoint, with communities around data center projects raising concerns over their impact on local supply of energy, water and other natural resources. Brokerage William Blair said while this news intensifies worries about regulatory and power-related delays affecting AI deployments, it expects minimal short-term impact on Oracle. "Practically, fiscal 2027 should not be affected, since Jupiter contributes no revenue this year."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請、19.7万件に減少－歴史的な低水準にとどまる
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 先週の米新規失業保険申請件数は前週比で減少し、7月以来の低水準となった。労働市場が全般に安定を保つ中、レイオフが引き続き少ないことを示唆した。

失業保険申請件数は1969年以降で見ても、屈指の低水準となった。継続受給者数は2023年以来の低水準付近で推移した。

企業は人員削減に慎重な姿勢を維持している。一方、採用にはばらつきがあり、転職を希望する人や労働市場から離れている人にとって、雇用機会は限られている。

より変動の少ない新規申請件数の4週移動平均は20万2250件に減少し、6週間ぶりの低水準となった。

季節調整前ベースでは、新規申請件数は増加した。特にカリフォルニア、ハワイ、ニューヨーク各州での増加が目立った。

ブルームバーグ・エコノミクス（BE）のイライザ・ウィンガー氏はリポートで、「9月半ばの新規失業保険申請件数は極めて低い水準を維持しており、労働市場が安定していることを示している。人員を削減している一部の業種では、効率化が主な目的とみられる。一方、金利上昇が人員削減につながっている兆候は、金利の影響を最も受けやすい業種でもまだ見られない」と指摘した。

原題：US Jobless Claims Slip to 197,000, Remain Historically Low (2)（抜粋）

item.title: Joshua and Fury to face off in Cardiff on December 11
item.description: The long-awaited showdown between British former heavyweight champions Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury will take place in Cardiff on December 11, promoter Turki Alalshikh announced on social media on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The long-awaited showdown between British former heavyweight champions Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury will take place in Cardiff on December 11, promoter Turki Alalshikh announced on social media on Thursday. Fury and Joshua ruled the division for much of the past decade, but a bout between them to unify all the major belts never came to fruition. Both were later beaten by Oleksandr Usyk, who became the undisputed heavyweight champion. "For 15 years no one has been able to make this fight... I can now confirm that Fury Vs Joshua will be coming to the UK, as I promised British boxing fans," Alalshikh posted on X. Joshua and Fury will fight for the vacant WBA 'Super' heavyweight title, Ring Magazine reported. The publication, which is owned by Alalshikh, is also serving as a promoter for the bout. The belt, which Usyk took from Joshua in 2021, was [USN:L6N42Y12C TEXT:"vacated by the Ukrainian"] in June. "I am inspiring a generation," Joshua posted on Instagram, reacting to the fight announcement. The bout will take place in Cardiff's Principality Stadium, after media reports said the promoters had previously proposed to stage it at New York's Madison Square Garden. Joshua's promoter Eddie Hearn told The Independent last month that they had insisted on the fight taking place in the United Kingdom. "We don’t want the money, we’d rather it was in the UK," Hearn told the British newspaper. Fury, 38, is coming off a win over Mariusz Wach, while 36-year-old Joshua [USN:L6N43S020 TEXT:"knocked out Kristian Prenga"] in July.

item.title: US weekly jobless claims near 57-year lows; price reductions boost new home sales
item.description: New claims for US unemployment benefits hovered near 57-year lows last week, suggesting the labor market regained momentum after struggling through much of summer and was so far weathering headwinds from the Middle East conflict.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: New claims for US unemployment benefits hovered near 57-year lows last week, suggesting the labor market regained momentum after struggling through much of summer and was so far weathering headwinds from the Middle East conflict. The Labor Department's weekly jobless claims report on Thursday, the latest gauge of economic health, suggested the unemployment rate remained steady at 4.1% this month. The number of people collecting unemployment checks was near three-year lows during the week the government surveyed households for September's jobless rate. The US-Israeli war has raised energy prices, with diesel hitting record highs. Economists said this will eventually stoke inflation and restrain economic activity. On Wednesday, a [USN:ZON00GJOX TEXT:"survey"] from S&P Global showed business activity increased in September to the highest in more than five years, with mounting price pressures. "It is a race against time perhaps as energy prices have kicked up again as the Iran war stretches on and the economy could always suffer through a soft patch in demand," said Christopher Rupkey, chief economist at FWDBONDS. "But in mid-September the economy seems to be firing on all cylinders in part due to the extraordinary capex expenditures on AI." Initial claims for state unemployment benefits slipped 1,000 to a seasonally adjusted 197,000 for the week ended September 19, the Labor Department said. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 201,000 weekly claims. Claims are near levels last seen in 1969. Economists have cited difficulties seasonally adjusting the data around the moving Labor Day holiday. They also noted what they call residual seasonality, which pushes claims lower as the year winds down. Still, the underlying trend in claims remains in line with a labor market that has regained its footing. The four-week moving average of claims, which irons out week-to-week volatility, fell 1,750 to 202,250 last week. Low layoffs account for much of the labor market stability, with companies not in a rush to boost headcount. While companies are hoarding workers, they remain hesitant to ramp up hiring, with economists blaming uncertainty stemming from the Iran war and tariffs on imports. Worker shortages during an immigration crackdown and retirements have shrunk the labor supply and are also hindering hiring. The S&P Global survey noted that companies in September were "also reporting increasing problems finding suitable staff." ANOTHER FED RATE HIKE ANTICIPATED Labor market stability supports expectations that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates again before year end as it battles inflation. The US central bank last week lifted its overnight benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range, the first raise in three years. Policy makers flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead, and investors were pricing in a 64.2% chance of another rate increase next month, CME's FedWatch tool showed. US stocks were trading lower as oil prices rose. The dollar gained versus a basket of currencies. US Treasury yields increased, with the yield on the [USN:L8N45G0KO TEXT:"30-year bond"] climbing to just over 5.45%, its highest since 2004. "More than a year ago, weak labor demand and a rising unemployment rate had Fed officials focused on balancing downside risk to employment with upside risk to inflation," said Andrew Hollenhorst, chief U.S. economist at Citigroup. "But at least for now, stable labor market data have convinced most Fed officials that downside employment risks have been so diminished that focus can shift entirely toward inflation." The number of people receiving unemployment benefits after an initial week of aid, a proxy for hiring, increased 2,000 to a seasonally adjusted 1.719 million during the week ended September 12. The small increase left continuing claims near levels last seen in May 2023. Continuing claims fell between the August and September survey weeks for the unemployment rate. The Chicago Fed forecast the jobless rate unchanged at 4.1% in September. Still, long bouts of unemployment are rampant for some. Rising mortgage rates in line with soaring Treasury yields are choking the housing market despite a price cut and incentives-driven surge in new single-family home sales in August. Home sales jumped 6.4% to a seasonally adjusted annualized rate of 684,000 units last month, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said in a separate report, beating the 615,000-unit rate that economists had forecast. It was the highest level since December 2025. Sales fell 2.0% in August from a year ago. The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaged 7.03% this week, its highest since January 2025, mortgage finance firm Freddie Mac said in a third report. That was up from 6.95% last week. It has jumped more than 100 basis points since the Iran war started at the end of February. Last week, a National Association of [USN:S0N41C02K TEXT:"Home Builders"] survey showed more builders cutting prices and offering incentives to lure buyers. Still, the glut of unsold new homes persisted. The median new house price dropped 5.8% to $393,700 in August from a year earlier, the Census report showed. The inventory of unsold new homes remained large and could further constrain new housing projects by builders. The supply of new houses on the market was unchanged at 483,000 units. More than half were under construction. At the August sales pace, it would take 8.5 months to clear the inventory, down from 9.0 months in July. Economists believe residential investment, which includes homebuilding and sales, has resumed its downward trend after a modest rebound in the second quarter. "These incentives are aimed at allowing for greater affordability for many, but we do not see them lasting indefinitely," said Jonathan Millar, a senior US economist at Barclays.

item.title: Casa Branca restabelece acesso de CNN, MS NOW e Politico após ordem judicial
item.description: A Casa Branca informou nesta quinta-feira que restabeleceu as credenciais de jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico, depois que um juiz federal considerou provável a inconstitucionalidade da proibição imposta pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, aos três veículos de imprensa e ordenou a restauração imediata de seu acesso.
item.dc:creator: Susan Heavey, Helen Coster
item.content:encoded: A Casa Branca informou nesta quinta-feira que restabeleceu as credenciais de jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico, depois que um juiz federal considerou provável a inconstitucionalidade da proibição imposta pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, aos três veículos de imprensa e ordenou a restauração imediata de seu acesso. O restabelecimento do acesso ocorreu após algumas horas de caos na manhã de quinta-feira, quando os jornalistas continuavam sendo impedidos de entrar nas dependências da Casa Branca. Isso levou as três organizações de notícias a solicitar uma audiência imediata com o juiz distrital dos EUA Tim Kelly, que emitiu sua decisão durante a noite. Kelly, atuando em uma ação judicial movida por CNN, MS NOW e Politico na segunda-feira, ordenou a suspensão da proibição de Trump por 14 dias, em um caso sobre liberdade de imprensa que se desenrolou ao longo da semana tanto no tribunal quanto nas dependências da Casa Branca. Kelly concluiu que a revogação das credenciais dos jornalistas na Casa Branca "provavelmente violava seus direitos constitucionais ao devido processo legal". O juiz, nomeado por Trump em 2017 durante seu primeiro mandato presidencial, também levantou dúvidas sobre os argumentos de segurança nacional apresentados pelo Departamento de Justiça dos EUA para justificar a proibição, observando que o próprio Trump havia dito que a medida se devia ao que o presidente alegava ser uma cobertura falsa ou negativa. Horas depois de Kelly emitir sua ordem, CNN, MS NOW e Politico informaram ao juiz que continuavam impedidos de entrar e solicitaram a audiência de emergência. O Politico afirmou que as credenciais de seu repórter haviam sido confiscadas. Uma repórter da MS NOW disse ter sido impedida de entrar na Casa Branca. A CNN relatou que alguns de seus funcionários tiveram a entrada negada nas dependências. Em resposta, Micah Stopperich, diretor de operações de imprensa da Casa Branca, declarou em um documento judicial que a Casa Branca iniciou o processo de restabelecimento dos crachás de imprensa para os repórteres afetados às 7h25 e que a "equipe de imprensa da Casa Branca deixou os crachás no portão de entrada para que os membros da imprensa os retirassem por volta das 9h55". PREOCUPAÇÕES COM A SEGURANÇA NACIONAL Trump anunciou a proibição na sexta-feira passada em sua plataforma de rede social, afirmando que essas organizações de notícias "não deveriam poder escrever ou relatar constantemente FICÇÃO e MENTIRAS ao cobrir o Presidente dos Estados Unidos". Trump classificou as reportagens desses veículos como uma ameaça à segurança nacional dos EUA. Os três veículos de imprensa processaram Trump e outros membros de seu governo, alegando que a proibição violava as proteções da Primeira Emenda da Constituição dos EUA à liberdade de expressão e de imprensa, bem como seus direitos ao devido processo legal. Uma coalizão de grupos de defesa da liberdade de imprensa e dezenas de organizações jornalísticas, incluindo a Reuters, apresentaram posteriormente uma manifestação jurídica apoiando os três veículos. Kelly ordenou que o governo Trump devolvesse imediatamente as credenciais de imprensa dos veículos e suspendesse a proibição por duas semanas. O juiz rejeitou as alegações do governo sobre riscos à segurança nacional. "Os autos carecem de embasamento factual para a alegação dos réus de que a revogação das credenciais permanentes dos autores protegerá, de fato, a segurança nacional, ou de que a segurança nacional será colocada em risco se o tribunal ordenar a restituição das credenciais enquanto o litígio prossegue", escreveu Kelly. Em uma petição apresentada na terça-feira, o Departamento de Justiça acusou os veículos de ameaçarem a segurança nacional com sua cobertura, citando reportagens sobre estoques de mísseis dos EUA, a construção do salão de baile da Casa Branca durante o governo Trump e o comparecimento à recente convenção republicana de meio de mandato. Theodore Boutrous, advogado dos três veículos, saudou a decisão do juiz em um comunicado, afirmando: "Esta é uma decisão contundente que reafirma a liberdade de imprensa, o devido processo legal e o Estado de Direito. Agradecemos imensamente a ação rápida do tribunal."

item.title: ミレニアム出身メギア氏のファンド、年初来9.4%損失－金利市場が混乱
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： マクロトレーダーが変動の激しい市場に直面する中、ディエゴ・メギア氏率いるタウラ・キャピタル・マネジメントは今月、4.3%の損失を出している。

運用成績に詳しい関係者によると、同ヘッジファンドの9月18日までの年初来運用成績はこれで9.4%のマイナスとなった。3月以降の回復が一部帳消しになったという。運用成績が非公開だとして、関係者は匿名を条件に語った。

タウラが今月、どのような取引で損失を出したかは明らかではない。ただ、9月の金利市場は大きく混乱した。米金融政策当局が2023年以来となる利上げを実施した後、2年債利回りが数日のうちに急上昇。ブレント原油が1バレル＝100ドルを上回ると、今月前半には世界的に金利見通しが急速に見直され、各国のイールドカーブがフラット化した。

タウラは今年初め、米国とイスラエルがイランへの攻撃を開始した際に損失を出したヘッジファンドの一つだった。エネルギーショックで中央銀行による利下げ観測が崩れ、マクロの見通しが一変した。その後、今月に入るまでは回復基調をたどっていた。

米ミレニアム・マネジメントでかつて資産運用を手掛けていたメギア氏は2024年にタウラを設立。業界史上最大級のヘッジファンド立ち上げだった。

原題：Hedge Fund Taula Down 9.4% in Volatile Year for Macro Traders

--取材協力：Liza Tetley、Hema Parmar.

item.title: サウジ、フーシ派のミサイル6発迎撃 紅海の主要港も標的
item.description:
Mohammed Ghobari Timour Azhari
[２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mohammed Ghobari　Timour Azhari

[２４日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアは、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が２４日に発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃し、南部タイフと紅海沿岸のヤンブー地区への攻撃を阻止した。イエメンでのサウジ主導連合が明らかにした。

広い地域に緊急警報が出されたが、タイフまたはヤンブーで何らかの被害や死傷者が出たかは明らかになっていない。ヤンブーはサウジ産原油の主要な代替輸送ルートだ。攻撃を受けた東西パイプラインの稼働が再開し、同地にあるターミナルからの原油輸出再開の見通しが改善したばかりだった。

民間防衛筋によると、ヨルダン国境に近い北西部タブーク州にも危険が及ぶ可能性がある。今月に入って激化するサウジとフーシ派の対立の中で、同地域が対象となるのは初めて。

連合は攻撃直後の声明で「テロ組織フーシ派によるいかなる激化や違反行為にも、断固として対処する」と表明した。

これより先、サウジの支援を受けるイエメン政府軍は、南部の港湾都市アデンへとつながる重要な補給路に対してフーシ派が夜間に仕掛けた攻撃を撃退した。政府筋が２４日に明らかにした。

「ヘジャト・アル・アブド」として知られる険しく曲がりくねった山岳道路はイエメン政府を支持して戦う部隊にとっての生命線となっている。イエメン第３の都市タイズや、その南・西部の農村地域へ物資を運ぶ上でも極めて重要だ。また、フーシ派支配地域からは民間便が運航されていないため、海外へ渡航しようとする住民にとって唯一のルートとなっている。

フーシ派は、イエメン西海岸沿いの攻勢により紅海の戦略的要衝であるバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡の沿岸に到達して以来、その成果を固めようと、政府軍への圧力を強め続けている。

タイズ－アデン道路の一部を制圧することでフーシ派はタイズ周辺の包囲網を強化し、政府にさらなる打撃を与えることができる。

フーシ派が紅海沿岸を南下する中、ここ数週間はタイズ周辺を含む複数の旧前線で戦闘が再燃している。
